post.originalText:
Gemini 4 Argon vs Opus 5.5 vs Astra vs Kimi K3

I asked Argon to build the Eiffel Tower in Paris in Three.js.

Argon’s tower structure is not good. Astra and Kimi come closest to the real Eiffel Tower.

Which one looks best to you? https://t.co/85uxyRBzDZ
